title: Payton Tolle pitches 8-inning gem as Red Sox end 5-game skid with 7-0 win over Blue Jays
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Rookie Payton Tolle pitched eight scoreless innings, leading the Red Sox to a 7-0 win over the Blue Jays.
Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam, finishing 3-for-5, as Boston snapped a five-game losing streak.
Red Sox maintain a strong position for an AL wild-card despite matching their worst skid of the season.

title: Patriots vs. Colts live coverage: Who will stand out in Patriots’ preseason opener?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The New England Patriots host the Indianapolis Colts for a preseason opener at Gillette Stadium, kickoff at 7:30 p.m.
Key starters like Drake Maye and A.J. Brown aren't expected to play, offering younger players a chance to impress.
Running back Terrell Jennings is placed on season-ending IR, opening opportunities for JaMychal Hasty and Lan Larison.

title: Cape Cod documentarian Mischa Richter creates a dreamy ode to Grateful Dead culture with ‘Summer Tour’
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Mischa Richter's documentary 'Summer Tour' follows Dead & Co.'s final tour with two young Grateful Dead fans.
The film features Jeremiah Pierce and Annie Dunn, who embody the modern Grateful Dead culture and community.
Chloë Sevigny co-produced the film, and it screens on August 16 at Cape Cinema and other New England venues.

title: Tiffani Faison to close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand in the Fenway
author: Nathan Tavares
bullets: Tiffani Faison will close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool's Errand in Fenway, ending Sweet Cheeks' 15-year run on November 24.
Sweet Cheeks Q was recognized as Boston's top barbecue spot, repeatedly winning 'Best of Boston' awards and media features.
Faison cites high costs and challenging economic conditions as reasons for not renewing the leases, affecting Boston's dining scene.

title: Take a look inside New Hampshire’s oldest continuously operated inn after a makeover
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: The Inn at Hancock in New Hampshire reopened in May after a three-year, multi-million dollar renovation.
The 1789-established inn offers 15 rooms with modern amenities, bespoke furnishings, and period antiques.
Dining options include The Restaurant, Hunt Bar & Scullery, and PINKS Lounge, featuring locally sourced ingredients.

title: Acton teen accused of killing mom, brother ordered held without bail
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Arjun Aravind, 17, accused of killing his mother and brother, was held without bail in Concord District Court.
Victims Sudha Venkatesan and Siddharth Aravind suffered blunt force trauma; their bodies were found in an Acton home.
Aravind faces multiple charges, including murder; his mental health evaluation is pending with a probable cause hearing set for September.

title: Downtown Boston was buzzing in July. Here’s a look at the numbers.
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Downtown Boston's foot traffic increased 10.5% in July 2026 compared to July 2025, driven by major events.
Weekend foot traffic in downtown Boston reached 104% of 2019 levels, while weekday traffic is 75% of 2019.
Temple Place businesses saw a 40% sales increase during Boston's World Cup events and social district pilot.

title: 2 seriously injured in West End stabbing, police say
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A man and a woman were seriously injured in a domestic-related stabbing in Boston's West End.
Police found the pair in a building's rear hallway on Lancaster Street, near North Station.
The man's injuries were self-inflicted and life-threatening, while the woman's injuries were not.

title: Healey temporarily restricts kratom sales statewide
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Governor Maura Healey restricts kratom statewide, designating it as a Schedule I substance due to high abuse potential.
The restriction follows concerns about synthetic kratom compounds and their availability in local stores, raising public safety risks.
Massachusetts joins other states in restricting kratom, with 14 states banning it and others placing age restrictions.

title: Two New England beach towns to visit before the summer ends
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich, Cape Cod was voted best town on the Cape by Boston.com readers, praised for beaches and sunset cruises.
Ogunquit, Maine is recommended as a must-visit beach town, recently named best in New England by Boston.com readers.
The Deerfield Fair in New Hampshire, New England’s oldest family fair, occurs October 1-4, featuring horse shows and live entertainment.
